description: This file defines the Enforcer interface, which specifies methods for permission checks, subject retrievals, and JSON view building based on permissions within an authorization system. It is part of a security enforcement module in the Eclipse Ditto framework, dealing with access control policies.

methods.name: hasUnrestrictedPermissions
methods.description: Default method that checks permissions using permission strings by constructing Permissions object.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPermission
methods.description: Returns subject IDs granted or revoked permissions on a resource, considering hierarchy, deprecated.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPermission
methods.description: Returns authorization subjects with granted or revoked permissions on a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Returns subject IDs with permissions granted on a resource and its sub-resources, hierarchy not considered.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Returns subjects with partial permissions on a resource and its sub-resources.

methods.name: buildJsonView
methods.description: Constructs a JSON view containing only fields permitted for the given authorization context and permissions.

methods.name: hasPartialPermissions
methods.description: Default method that checks for partial permissions using permission strings; hierarchy considered.
